english.title: Unlawfully use a disabled person's badge in relation to the parking of a vehicle

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: chronically sick and disabled persons act 1970

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[acted in contravention of]_
(B)_[failed to comply with]_

a provision of an order under the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984, namely **(..SPECIFY PROVISION AND ORDER..), relating to the parking of motor vehicles and at that time there was displayed on the motor vehicle a badge of a form prescribed under section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970, and you were using the vehicle in circumstances where a disabled person's concession would have been available to a disabled person's vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to Section 117(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
Disabled person's concession means
(a) an exemption from an order under the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 given by reference to disabled persons' vehicles OR
(b) a provision made in any order under the Act for the use of a parking place by disabled persons' vehicles.
